intro.h2: More room, planned around your life
paragraphs: Elevate Builders, LLC is a general contractor taking on home additions and remodeling in Houston, TX. When a family needs more space, we plan the addition with them and set the schedule around their dates. One homeowner hired us for an addition with a baby due in early November and told us the project appeared to be on schedule at the midpoint.

We work with a reliable team of long-standing contractors, and our aim on every job is to stay diligent, organized and consistent from start to finish. Our photos show the kind of interiors we like to deliver: open kitchens, big islands and bright living spaces.

items.name: Home additions
items.blurb: Need another bedroom, a bigger living area or a nursery before a due date? We build additions that tie into the house you already have, and we plan the timeline with you up front so the work fits the dates your family is counting on.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: The kitchen shown here centers on a long white waterfall island under glass pendants. Dark stained shaker cabinets, glass-front uppers, a black and white patterned backsplash, double wall ovens and a wine fridge fill out the room.

image.alt: Kitchen with a white waterfall island, glass pendants, dark stained cabinets and a patterned black and white backsplash

items.name: Open living spaces
items.blurb: We like rooms that flow. This open plan joins a white shaker kitchen and island to a living area under a vaulted ceiling with a cedar beam and a round iron chandelier, with arched openings to the mudroom and hall.

image.alt: Open kitchen and living area with a vaulted ceiling, cedar beam, round chandelier, white shaker cabinets and light wood-look floors

items.title: Your dates come first
items.text: One family put us on a tight timeline with a baby due in early November. We plan schedules around dates like that and aim to hit completion as accurately as we can.

about.text: Elevate Builders, LLC is a general contractor serving Houston, TX. We focus on home additions and on remodeling kitchens and living spaces. Rodrigo is one of the people homeowners work with on site, and our crew is made up of long-standing contractors who know how we run a job. We believe a good project is diligent, organized and consistent, and that the schedule should be built around what is happening in your life. Call us Monday through Saturday to start the conversation.

process.h2: How a project with us runs

steps.title: First call
steps.text: Call (346) 970-3653, Monday to Saturday from 9 AM to 7 PM, and tell us what you want to build or change.

steps.title: Set the timeline
steps.text: We walk the house, talk through the scope and plan the schedule around the dates that matter to your family.

steps.title: Build with our crew
steps.text: Our long-standing team of contractors does the work, keeping the job organized and moving from one stage to the next.

steps.title: Keep you posted
steps.text: You hear from us as the project moves along, including straight answers when something on the schedule needs to change.

steps.title: Walk it together
steps.text: We go through the finished space with you and work through any punch-list items before we call the job complete.

items.name: Sofia T.
items.text: We are midway through a home addition project with Elevate and so far I only have great things to say. We have Rodrigo on a tight timeline as I’m due for a baby in early November and we appear to be on schedule. It is clear they have a reliable team of long standing contractors. I will update once our project is finalized if anything changes but so far our project seems to be progressing really well and we are excited to see the final result!

service_area.h2: Home additions and remodeling in Houston, TX
service_area.text: Elevate Builders works in Houston, TX. Our Google profile does not list a street address or a set service area yet, so if you are in the Houston area and wondering whether we can take on your project, the quickest answer is a phone call. Reach us at (346) 970-3653, Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 7 PM, and tell us your neighborhood.

items.a: Yes. Home additions are one of our main projects. One family hired us for an addition and, at the halfway point, told us they had only great things to say. Call us to talk through how much space you need and how it would connect to your current house.

items.q: Can you work to a deadline?
items.a: We plan every schedule around your dates and aim to hit completion as accurately as possible. One homeowner gave us a tight timeline with a baby due in early November, and the project appeared to be on schedule midway through. Tell us your key dates at the first meeting.

Yes. Our photos show a kitchen with a long white waterfall island and dark stained cabinets, and an open white shaker kitchen under a vaulted ceiling. We can talk through layout, cabinets, counters and how the kitchen connects to the rest of your living space.

items.q: Who will be working in my home?
items.a: Our crew is a reliable team of long-standing contractors, which a homeowner noticed and mentioned in her review. Rodrigo is one of the people customers work with on site. Ask us during your first call who will run your project day to day.

We are open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 7 PM and closed on Sunday. Call (346) 970-3653 or email elevatebuildersinfo@gmail.com with a short description of the project, a few photos of the space and the timing you have in mind.

final_cta.h2: Planning an addition or a remodel?
final_cta.text: Call Elevate Builders and tell us the dates you are working toward.
